title: Integrate room_id backend wiring and frontend room state
description:
Connect backend room_id functionality to frontend UI state. Before editing, inspect:
- backend/api.py for room_id creation and management
- frontend/src/App.tsx for room state initialization
Implementation:
1. Modify backend handler to include room_id in API responses
2. Update frontend App.tsx to store room_id in room state context
3. Handle UI mounting logic based on room state availability
4. Add TypeScript interfaces for room state object
